notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Garth One-Eye.
description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, exiling and returning onto the battlefield.
Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
